newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago futures.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow lower Chicago futures.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers followed last week's limit-down close in Chicago on Monday morning.
However, buyers were not keen to jump in with many hoping for further falls during Monday afternoon.
High protein soymeal ex-mill Liverpool was offered two to six stg down while store prices were 4.75 to two stg lower.
Brazilian 48's were down around five stg a tonne.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was offered four to six stg lower while the Liverpool and Hull mills were two to four stg down.
Corn gluten feed pellets ex-store Liverpool lost three to four stg while Portbury prices were five to six stg lower.
Sunflower pellets ex-mill Erith were offered one stg down while imported meal was two to 2.50 stg lower on the east coast. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
